item.text: [{"task_id":"99fa7670","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['background'][0]))","    directions = []","    for vector in params['directions']:","        directions.append((int(round(vector[0])), int(round(vector[1]))))","    out = grid.copy()","    height, width = grid.shape","    seeds = np.argwhere(grid != background)","    for seed in seeds:","        row, col = int(seed[0]), int(seed[1])","        color = int(grid[row, col])","        for dr, dc in directions:","            if dr == 0 and dc == 0:","                continue","            while 0 <= row + dr < height and 0 <= col + dc < width:","                row += dr","                col += dc","                out[row, col] = color","    return out"],"shapes":{"background":[1],"directions":[2,2]},"params":{"background":[0],"directions":[[0,1],[1,0]]},"rationale":"Each nonbackground seed extends right to the edge, then downward along that edge. Seeds are processed from top to bottom, so each lower seed replaces the preceding color below its row. The tensors encode the background and both travel directions."}]
